about.title: About DuoMatch
about.lead: Behind every family, there was a day when two strangers looked at each other differently.
about.mission: We’re building DuoMatch to make serious dating and beautiful stories easier between adults, in francophone Africa and beyond, in an environment where everyone feels safe.

respect.title: Respect
respect.text: No harassment, no shocking content. Our community rules are enforced.

safety.title: Safety
safety.text: Human moderation, blocking, reporting and action against fake profiles and scams.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.text: Blurred location, export and deletion of your data at any time.

sincerity.title: Sincerity
sincerity.text: A verified badge is only earned after a real check. No fake testimonials.

c1.title: It all starts with a glance
c1.p1: Every great family has a first chapter. A glance across a wedding hall, a shy message sent one evening, a “hello” that could have gone unanswered. Nobody plans that tiny moment, yet everything else flows from it: the home, the children, Sunday meals, the laughter, the silences that reassure.
c1.p2: We started from a simple conviction: that first chapter deserves every chance.

c2.title: Meeting people has never been so easy… or so hard
c2.p1: We’re more connected than ever, yet so many sincere people feel alone. Too many profiles, too many promises, too many conversations that fade after two messages. Many are looking for someone to build something real with, and end up lost in the noise, sometimes exposed to fake profiles and scams.
c2.p2: DuoMatch was born for those who want something else: less showcase, more meaning.

c3.title: A platform built to build, not to consume
c3.p1: Here, we don’t ask you to be perfect, we help you be understood. Your intentions, values, interests, city and languages matter more than any photo. Our compatibility score is never based on appearance.
c3.p2: And when two people truly like each other, live matching lets them talk right away, while they’re both there, with a genuine wish to connect.

c4.title: Trust is the first foundation
c4.p1: You can’t build a family on doubt. That’s why we keep the platform for adults, moderate with real people, grant the “verified” badge only after a real check, blur your location, and let you export or delete your data whenever you want.
c4.p2: Every rule we enforce has the same purpose: so you can open your heart without lowering your guard.

c5.title: Our dream: families that begin here
c5.p1: We dream of the day a couple tells us: “We met on DuoMatch.” Of the day children ask how their parents met, and the answer begins with a simple profile, a simple “Like”.
c5.p2: We don’t sell promises. We build the conditions for beautiful stories to happen: a respectful, safe, human-sized place, in francophone Africa and beyond.

about.nextTitle: The next one might be you.
about.nextText: Somewhere, the person who will change your life may be creating their profile right now. And the next family story we tell may well be that of whoever is reading these lines. Your first chapter starts here.

help.title: Help center
help.lead: Answers to the most common questions.

verify.q: I didn’t receive the confirmation email
verify.a: Check your spam folder, then use “Resend” in the banner at the top of the app.

password.a: On the login page, choose “Forgot password”: a link valid for one hour is emailed to you.

sessions.q: How do I log out of another device?
sessions.a: Settings → Security → Connected devices, then “Log out”.

delete.q: How do I delete my account?
delete.a: Settings → Privacy → Delete my account. This is permanent.

scam.q: How do I spot a romance scam?
scam.a: Beware of any request for money, a constant refusal to appear on video, or a very fast declaration of love. Report the profile.

report.q: How do I report a profile?
report.a: Open the profile or conversation, then “Report”. A moderator reviews every report.

block.q: What happens if I block someone?
block.a: You no longer see each other and the conversation is closed. You can unblock from settings.

verified.q: How do I get the verified badge?
verified.a: Profile → Verification: send a selfie. A moderator compares it to your photos, then deletes the selfie.

pay.a: Payment goes through a secure provider; the available methods depend on your country.

cancel.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
cancel.a: Settings → Subscription → Cancel. You keep your benefits until the end of the paid period.

invoice.a: Settings → Payments: every successful payment has an invoice.

failed.a: No benefit is activated until the payment is confirmed. Try again from the Premium page.

location.a: Never precisely: only a rounded distance may appear, and only if you share your location.

export.q: Can I get my data back?
export.a: Yes: Settings → Privacy → Export my data (JSON file).

visibility.q: How do I hide my profile?
visibility.a: Settings → Privacy → turn off “Visible profile”. Incognito mode is reserved for VIP.

sections.p: DuoMatch is a matchmaking service between adults. These terms govern its use.
The service is reserved for people aged at least 18. False age information leads to account deletion.
You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and your profile information accurate.
Harassment, impersonation, requests for money, unlawful or sexually explicit content, commercial solicitation.
Premium and VIP plans are monthly, with no commitment, and can be cancelled at any time. Benefits remain until the end of the paid period.
DuoMatch may warn, suspend or remove an account that breaks the rules. An appeal procedure is available.
DuoMatch connects members but does not guarantee their identity or intentions. Stay cautious when meeting.
Email, date of birth, gender, city, photos, bio, interests, interactions (likes, messages), payment data processed by the provider.
Provide the service, suggest compatible profiles, ensure safety and moderation, manage subscriptions.
Your exact location is never stored or shown: if you share it, it is rounded (about 11 km) before saving.
Metadata (EXIF, GPS) is removed on upload. Verification selfies are deleted after a decision.
Access, correction, export (Settings → Privacy), account deletion, withdrawal of marketing consent at any time.
Data is deleted or anonymized when you delete your account, subject to legal obligations (billing, security).
A secure (httpOnly) session cookie keeps you signed in. It is essential for the service to work.
Your theme choice (light/dark) is stored locally in your browser.
No advertising tracker is used. Any future analytics tool will ask for your prior consent.
Treat everyone with courtesy. Insults, discrimination and harassment are prohibited.
Use your real photos and information. Fake profiles are removed.
Never ask for money or financial help. Report any such request.
No sexually explicit, violent or illegal content. Photos of minors are forbidden.
Report any behavior that breaks these rules; our team reviews every report.

renew.a: No. Mobile Money payments do not allow reliable recurring debits: each period is a one-off payment. We notify you before the end so you can extend.

refund.a: Write to us via the Contact page with your payment reference: each request is reviewed, notably for double payments or errors.

guarantee.a: No. No subscription guarantees a match or a relationship: it gives you more visibility and tools.
